recommendation.explanationSummary: Higher-beta AI infrastructure basket for users who want a more concentrated compute and tooling tilt.

explanationBundle.whatThisPortfolioDoes: Higher-beta AI infrastructure basket for users who want a more concentrated compute and tooling tilt. It keeps 2% in AUSD as a yield buffer instead of forcing full equity exposure.
explanationBundle.howItIsBuilt: 98% stays in xStocks across 5 names. 2% remains in AUSD. Largest sleeves: NVDAx 22%, AMDx 20.08%, AVGOx 19.3%. Starts from the pinned AI Infra basket membership. Selects names from the core universe. Keeps the basket at 5 names.
explanationBundle.howItChanges: Rebalance only when drift clears 275 bps. Authoritative path-dependent scoring implies 3.35% annualized turnover, 12.08 bps annualized costs, and 1 rebalance over the frozen window. Legacy static proxy would have printed 98% turnover and 44.3 bps total costs with 2% parked in AUSD.
explanationBundle.whatWouldTriggerNextRebalance: A rebalance only becomes actionable when drift clears 2.8% and the lane is still allowed to activate under current route truth. The repo does not prove an autonomous scheduler today.
explanationBundle.howToReadReplay: After estimated costs, the pinned run delivered 26.25% versus 13.16% for basket.sp500_core_v1, an excess of +13.09%. Treat replay as validation, not a promise of future returns.
explanationBundle.bestFor: Best for someone who wants AI Infra exposure through a curated xStocks basket with a visible 2% AUSD buffer and can accept elevated risk with roughly 22% in the largest name.

currentKnobs.label: Candidate family
currentKnobs.currentValue: Core Low Cash + Lower Rebalance Threshold
currentKnobs.tuningImpact: Keeps the winning core-universe low-cash structure for AI Infra but lowers the drift trigger so rebalance timing can compete under the richer path.

currentKnobs.label: Starter basket
currentKnobs.tuningImpact: Changes basket membership before weights are assigned.

currentKnobs.label: Selection universe
currentKnobs.tuningImpact: Widens the eligible pool beyond the starter basket without changing slot identity.

currentKnobs.label: Holdings breadth
currentKnobs.tuningImpact: Changes how many names survive ranking into the target basket.

currentKnobs.label: Starter anchor bias
currentKnobs.tuningImpact: Keeps the slot anchored to its starter basket even when broader selection is enabled.

currentKnobs.label: Ranking signal
currentKnobs.tuningImpact: Changes which names rise or fall inside the current basket.

currentKnobs.label: Weighting curve
currentKnobs.tuningImpact: Changes how aggressively higher-ranked names dominate the basket.

currentKnobs.label: Signal power
currentKnobs.tuningImpact: Makes the weighting curve flatter or more conviction-heavy without changing the underlying signal.

currentKnobs.label: Cash sleeve
currentKnobs.tuningImpact: Changes how much capital stays in AUSD instead of xStocks exposure.

currentKnobs.label: Single-name cap
currentKnobs.tuningImpact: Limits the maximum weight of one name.

currentKnobs.label: Rebalance trigger
currentKnobs.tuningImpact: Skips smaller drifts to reduce churn.
